decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct, conflicting assertions regarding the head of government of Dobreni. Document 1 (D1S2) explicitly states that 'Ioan Călin Andreș... served as the head of government of Dobreni.' Document 2 (D2S2) asserts that 'Dan Ceaușu... held the esteemed position of head of government in his hometown commune.' Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers when competing assertions exist without a mechanism to resolve them as errors, both names are included as the answer.
